title: Pomas
summary: A Windows desktop application for poultry farm record-keeping, batch management, feed and inventory, health records, egg production, sales, expenses, and reporting.
problem: Helps poultry farmers organize bookkeeping and calculate business performance and profit.
contribution: Defined the product specifications and requirements. Other implementation contributions will be documented only when verified.
publicNotes: Showcase screenshots must hide sensitive farm, customer, and financial records.
